'''Medeen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who served in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Galactic War]] and the [[War against Zakuul|war]] against the [[Eternal Empire]]. Medeen was recruited by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] to join him on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="TOR" />
